Added Projects (4f759655), Chat (e2dce399), Drive (b11cd01f) to A2eSuiteApplicationUniversalIdentifiers.ts and OnboardingInstallableApps.ts with proper Lingui labels and descriptions. docs/applications.md corrected. userStories.title: M1 Dockerfile — add twenty-apps-build stage building all 5 A2E apps into tarballs
userStories.description: As an operator deploying A2E Suite via Docker, I want the production image to contain built tarballs for all 5 A2E apps so that a fresh deploy automatically registers and installs them without manual app:publish rituals.
userStories.completionNotes: Done. Commit 5bfe5bef. New twenty-apps-build multi-stage: yarn install + yarn twenty dev:build --tarball for each of the 5 internal apps; tarballs collected at /app/packages/twenty-apps/dist in the server image. CI workflow (cd-docker-image.yaml) already uses GHA cache and will build this stage automatically. Tier-2 residual: docker build must complete and /app/packages/twenty-apps/dist must contain 5 tarballs in the image.

userStories.title: M1 startup registration — ProvisionBundledAppsCommand (app:provision-bundled) + BUNDLED source type + entrypoint.sh integration
userStories.description: As an operator on a fresh Docker deployment, I want the server to automatically register all bundled A2E app tarballs at startup and install them on all workspaces so that Settings → Applications shows the A2E section without manual CLI work.
userStories.completionNotes: Done. Commits 5bfe5bef + a437674f. ApplicationRegistrationSourceType.BUNDLED enum value; ApplicationRegistrationEntity.bundledAppSourcePath nullable text column with @WasIntroducedInUpgrade; 2-39 instance command (1789905000000) ADD COLUMN; ApplicationPackageFetcherService BUNDLED case resolves from FS path; ProvisionBundledAppsCommand (app:provision-bundled): reads *.tgz from BUNDLED_APPS_DIR, registers with sourceType=BUNDLED/isPreInstalled=true/ownerWorkspaceId=null, idempotent, --dry-run; DatabaseCommandModule wired; entrypoint.sh calls provision_bundled_apps() after setup_and_migrate_db (provision-bundled then install-pre-installed-apps); PreInstalledAppsService.installOnWorkspace improved (APP_ALREADY_INSTALLED no longer error-logs); 5-case spec file. Tier-2 residual: live Docker boot registering 5 apps + installing on all workspaces.
